what: Three INDEPENDENT 320-game runs of an identical configuration (overrides enabled, veto enabled), torch threads pinned, produced accidentally by a zsh word-splitting bug that swallowed each arm's flag into its tag.
finding: observed sd sits at the binomial floor, so with torch.set_num_threads(1) the panel's run-to-run variance is essentially pure sampling noise. The earlier estimate of sd 0.035 at n=400 -- derived from three baseline panels run under DIFFERENT concurrent load -- was inflated by contention, exactly as failures/DEFECT_panel_results_depended_on_machine_load.md predicted.
consequence: at n=320 a 95% interval is about +/-0.053, so differences below ~5 points are not resolvable and are reported as unresolved rather than interpreted.
